_comment: Single source of truth for Sapote-Mamey standing rules, retirements, and exclusions. Edit THIS file; mamey/rules.py loads it and tests/test_rules_registry.py guards it. A rule that lives only in a chat session or a preferences doc can be resurrected by a fresh, thin-context session. A rule that lives here is enforced by the linter.

rules.label: NAPAA (Nosema-associated hypothesis)
rules.rationale: Common and frequently adjacent to genuine BGCs; treated as NEUTRAL — neither downgraded nor excluded from comparative/ecological claims. (Nosema hypothesis remains retired, but that does not justify excluding NAPAA itself.)

rules.label: Saccharide class
rules.rationale: Permanent exclusion: saccharide-class BGCs are downgraded, never surfaced as discovery leads. RG-03: the \bsaccharide\b word boundary already prevents matching inside polysaccharide/lipopolysaccharide (no boundary before the 's'), and aminoglycoside has no 'saccharide' substring, so the former false_positive_guard list never engaged and was removed. The word boundary is what protects these classes.

rules.label: NIS-independent siderophore class
rules.rationale: Permanent exclusion (BH-007): NIS-independent siderophore capacity is an iron-acquisition function, not a drug-discovery lead. Downgraded when it is the BGC's own class; a committed NRPS/PKS/RiPP backbone that merely co-carries the siderophore arm keeps its lead via the committed-class guard.

rules.label: NRP-metallophore class
rules.rationale: Permanent exclusion (BH-007b): the metallophore component is a metal-acquisition function, not a drug lead. Downgraded only when no committed NRPS/PKS backbone is present — a real NRPS that also chelates metal keeps its lead via the committed-class guard.

rules.label: hglE-KS / PREV-001 / hexacosalactone
rules.rationale: Habitat-non-specific (8 strains / 7 genera / 3 habitats) — recorded as an informational property, NOT a downgrade. hglE-KS ranks as a normal lead; the §4.3 enediyne-artifact guard in scoring.py is separate and unchanged.

rules.label: BRYO-HGT-001
rules.rationale: Retired claim. Any reappearance in a verdict is a regression.

rules.label: Enediyne KnownClusterBlast hit
rules.rationale: Enediyne KCB is similarity, not identity -> [E-signal] claim downgrade (treat as enediyne candidate; structure NOT confirmed; PREV-001/hglE artifact when only a generic signal co-occurs). No lab-safety/BSL-2 flag is emitted: selective biosafety warnings give false reassurance (cytotoxic polyenes and other hazards go untagged), and chemical handling is governed by lab SOPs.

rules.label: Primary-metabolism call
rules.rationale: Primary-metabolism calls are dropped, never surfaced as natural-product discovery leads.

inventory_bottom_tier.scope: Lead_tier_auto routing only; no AB/AF/novelty mutation
inventory_bottom_tier.claim_ceiling: Routing-prior labels over antiSMASH class annotations; neither Low nor Inventory proves product identity, production, activity, novelty, pathway completeness, ecological function, or biological housekeeping. Judgment deferred.
inventory_bottom_tier.review_rule: Rows containing an ambiguous_review_token or only broadened housekeeping classes require a keyed human disposition before a cohort-level reviewed-Inventory claim.

_changelog.change: NAPAA->neutral, HGLE-KS-PREV-001->noted (un-excluded). Lead-blocking removed for both. Saccharide/primary-metabolism/enediyne-gate/bryo-HGT unchanged.

_changelog: 2026-06-24 v9.7.122: added NI-SIDEROPHORE (BH-007) and NRP-METALLOPHORE (BH-007b) downgrade rules; committed-class guard protects mixed-class leads.

2026-07-28 RG-03: removed the inert SACCHARIDE false_positive_guard list (the \bsaccharide\b word boundary already protects polysaccharide/lipopolysaccharide/aminoglycoside). RG-04: rules.py now validates status/action against the allowed enum sets at load. No behavior change to any live rule.

2026-08-04 AQUARIUS_01: added the governed inventory_bottom_tier routing policy. It class-gates only the below-Medium label (Low versus Inventory), changes no numeric prior, and carries an explicit claim ceiling and keyed-review rule.
